description: Panchang elements: tithi, vara, yoga, karana; daily-effect scoring notes; muhurat principles including Rahu Kaal.

tithis.description: 30 lunar days: 15 Shukla (waxing) + 15 Krishna (waning). Each = 12° Moon-Sun elongation.

names_shukla_or_krishna.name: Chaturthi
names_shukla_or_krishna.effect_note: Empty/rikta — avoid new starts; ok for clearing

names_shukla_or_krishna.name: Dwadashi
names_shukla_or_krishna.effect_note: Good for sacred and steady tasks

names_shukla_or_krishna.name: Chaturdashi
names_shukla_or_krishna.effect_note: Rikta — avoid new starts; worship ok

names_shukla_or_krishna.name: Purnima (Shukla) / Amavasya (Krishna)
names_shukla_or_krishna.effect_note: Purnima: fullness/celebration; Amavasya: endings, ancestors — avoid most new starts

tithis.daily_scoring_high_level: Prefer Nanda/Bhadra/Jaya/Purna for starts; penalize Rikta (4,9,14) and Amavasya for worldly beginnings. Prefer Shukla paksha for launches.

days.favor: Emotions, public, water, nurturing, travel short
Courage, competition, surgery/land (caution); avoid for soft starts
Discipline, labor, service; avoid for finance starts in many lists

movable.name: Kaulava
movable.effect: Mixed character; caution in classical texts

fixed.name: Kimstughna
fixed.effect: Opens Shukla Pratipada; Vaisvadeva yoga when so placed

karanas.calculation: Half-tithi = 6° Moon-Sun elongation; 60 karanas per lunar month

algorithm_steps: Inputs: birth date, time, place → compute sidereal Moon longitude (needs ephemeris + ayanamsa, commonly Lahiri). Do NOT invent live positions without an ephemeris.
Subsequent mahadashas follow the fixed sequence for full periods.
Antardasha: same 9-lord order starting from mahadasha lord; duration = (MD_years * AD_years) / 120.
vimshottari_dasha.commercial_flag: Dasha predictions marketed as fact need a licensed/credentialed Jyotishi; birth-time rectification is expert work. App may show algorithm and tables only.

rahu_kaal.method: Split sunrise→sunset into 8 equal parts; weekday selects which part is Rahu Kaal.
rahu_kaal.note: Avoid beginning auspicious work in Rahu Kaal; already-started work may continue. Times are local daylight-dependent — never hardcode clock ranges.

muhurat_principles: Prefer waxing Moon (Shukla paksha) for starts and launches.
Avoid Vishti/Bhadra karana for worldly auspicious beginnings.
Avoid Rikta tithis (4, 9, 14) and Amavasya for most new starts.
Avoid classic inauspicious yogas (Atiganda, Shula, Ganda, Vyaghata, Vyatipata, Parigha, Vaidhriti).
Subtract Rahu Kaal, Yamaganda, Gulika, Varjyam, Dur Muhurtam from candidate windows.
Match weekday lord to activity (e.g., Wednesday/Thursday/Friday for finance/deals; avoid Saturday for finance starts in many lists).
Prefer supportive nakshatras for the activity type (see activity tables in sources).
